correctness.rationale: For every finite connected simple bipartite G, any 5-vertex set contains 3 vertices from one bipartition, so dim I_3≤3; 2- and 3-faces are exactly triples containing an edge and quadruples carrying disjoint edges. The complete one-skeleton plus graph-edge triangles kills loops using a connected-graph fan. A leaf t attached to v has link(t)=v*Cl(H−v), hence deleting leaf t collapses I_3(H+t) to I_3(H); thus a tree is contractible. On adding any bipartite cross-edge ab to a connected spanning subgraph H, the new C_2 relative generators are triples {a,b,u} for vertices u adjacent to neither a nor b in H. The new C_3 relative boundary columns are signed graph incidences of old edges having ≥1 endpoint in U; connectivity of H implies each component of H[U] is connected to a vertex outside U∪{a,b}. A root path along a spanning forest supplies an integer coefficient ±1 expression for each generator, making ∂_3:C_3(L’,L;Z)→C_2(L’,L;Z) onto. H_2 of the growing complex stays zero from a spanning tree; with π_1=0 and top integral H_3 free, Hurewicz and homology Whitehead give a wedge of 3-spheres. Exact f_2=m(n−2)−sum_v binom(d_v,2), f_3=binom(m,2)−sum_v binom(d_v,2)−c_4 imply multiplicity binom(b+1,2)−c_4. Edge cases K_1 and trees work. Independent Python chain checks covered 231 connected small bipartite graphs over F_2,F_3,F_5, 673 old-edge additions, plus C_6,C_8,C_10,K_{3,4},K_{4,4}; their finite scope is not a universal integer proof.
residual_risks: The universal homotopy equivalence depends on exact integer path-to-sink surjectivity, not finite-field ranks; this graph-theoretic argument has been checked analytically.
The result does not address nonbipartite graphs, higher robust parameter or equivariant integral homology representations.

evidence: Filakovský Theorem 1 treats rectangular grids and Theorem 2 treats graphs obtained by successive C4 attachments. Arbitrary connected bipartite graphs (e.g. any C_6, trees and incidence graphs of girth ≥6) do not all belong to these families (arXiv:2602.11365v4).

Carnero Bravo Proposition 15 handles connected chordal graphs (including trees), Proposition 37 complete multipartite graphs, and Corollary 39 cycles; these jointly do not exhaust connected bipartite graphs (arXiv:2602.21427).

broader_coverage.reasoning: All-compartments representation/Euler coverage is broader in equivariance but strictly weaker for degreewise integral homology and homotopy. Prior full homotopy classifications apply to proper subclasses, and a general all-connected-graph simple-connectivity statement still leaves the H_2 obstruction.

Resultary equivariant Euler character and its lack of homotopy concentration
value.rationale: A complete integral homotopy classification for the natural three-bounded-independence complex of every connected bipartite graph is a meaningful infinite-family gap. The incidence-surjectivity lemma explains why arbitrary cross-edges added to trees cannot create degree-two homology; this general structural result is not a routine Euler identity. It unifies prior grid, square-sequence, tree, even-cycle and biclique cases and applies to high-girth bipartite incidence graphs and unrestricted degrees/attachments. Exact binom(b+1,2)−c4 multiplicity and the forced nonnegative four-cycle inequality are useful invariant information independent of finite examples.
residual_risks: Novelty is best-of-knowledge and may be narrowed by an unindexed universal theorem.
No new general theorem for robust k>3, nonbipartite graphs or symmetry representations is claimed.

limitations: No formal verification or outside expert attestation claimed; analytic proof supports the infinite statement; finite tests are independent checks.
Only the assigned one final claim has been judged; no publication or source write performed.
